gloss: to open; to establish; to set up

definitions.gloss: to open; to establish; to set up (a facility, service, or account)
definitions.explanation: To bring something newly into operation so that it is available for use — an office, a shelter, a bank account, a website, a phone line. The emphasis is on starting the service, not on constructing the building.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}を{開設|かいせつ}する。
{市|し}は{体育館|たいいくかん}に{避難所|ひなんじょ}を{開設|かいせつ}した。
examples.english: The city set up an evacuation shelter in the gymnasium.

examples.japanese: {相談|そうだん}を{受|う}け{付|つ}けるため、{専用|せんよう}の{窓口|まどぐち}を{開設|かいせつ}することになった。
examples.english: It has been decided to set up a dedicated help desk to receive inquiries.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; the thing opened takes を. The plain noun {開設|かいせつ} is common in notices: {窓口|まどぐち}{開設|かいせつ}のお{知|し}らせ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口座|こうざ}を{開設|かいせつ}する: to open a bank account
- {避難所|ひなんじょ}を{開設|かいせつ}する: to set up an evacuation shelter
- ホームページを{開設|かいせつ}する: to launch a website
- {窓口|まどぐち}を{開設|かいせつ}する: to open a service counter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {設立|せつりつ}する: to found, establish — used of organizations and companies as legal entities
- {開業|かいぎょう}する: to open for business — of a shop or practice starting trade
- {開|ひら}く: to open — the everyday verb, from doors to meetings
